post_window_focus.screenshot_scope: Actual aim/release screenshots taken after capture; not fullfade/shot acceptance.

native_metrics.scope: Godot monitors and instrumented inclusive wrappers; nested costs must not be added. Native capture is a separately timestamped subset of the encompassing browser window.

rate_formulas.observed_window_fps: RAF callbacks observed / full actual wall capture duration; callback throughput, not proof of GPU presentation
rate_formulas.completed_interval_fps: complete consecutive RAF intervals / their covered RAF timestamp span; must be read with coverage and uncovered boundary gaps

coverage.limitation: No extraGLquery/readback/finish. APIwalltime is not GPUduration; no kernel/drivertrace. Idleworker omissions explicitly retained. No timing claims for counts-only calls.
